capabilities: view and filter tasks across the vault by status and content
earn coins for completed tasks based on difficulty level
recreate recurring tasks from history when their time arrives
extras: Usage instructions are not in the README; it points to an external Getting Started guide.
motivation: The author wanted an average to-do list powered by earning coins, kept simple with automated actions around it.
problem: Obsidian's task support offers no motivation loop; completing tasks gives no tracked reward or progress feedback.
summary: Task manager with a rewards layer: earn coins by completing tasks based on difficulty, then spend them on rewards from a shop.
